exterior_term.boundary_basis: the authored analytic total field with its zero-level boundary; the production topology read and wall-contact level are not inputs
exterior_term.definition: analytic total flux minus the analytically integrated exact plasma-current moment image; constructed before mode selection

analytic_moments_anchor.definition: external plus analytically integrated exact moments

certificate_target_normalised_map.definition: the production certificate map with requested topology class and analytic total-current target

a_affine_residual.basis: constant plus raw R and Z in metres

b_external_term.certificate_external_definition: the external array captured by ForwardFluxOperator.flux_map
b_external_term.implied_exterior_definition: analytic total flux minus the evaluated booked internal image

c_internal_image.definition: evaluated booked internal image minus analytically integrated moments imaged through the same frozen blocks

unscaled_production_map.definition: production allocation and moment conversion without target-current normalisation, requested topology class fixed

per_cell_moment_attribution.definition: target-normalised production coupling moments minus fixture analytic coupling moments, per atomic cell, imaged through the frozen blocks
per_cell_moment_attribution.support_classification: cut means included with support area strictly between zero and full atomic area; whole means included at full area

residual_definitions.certificate_relative_residual: max(abs(mapped-state)) / max(abs(mapped)); recorded as a source pointer but not substituted for the span-normalized map floor
residual_definitions.jacobian: state minus the target-normalised map on the residual shadow frozen at the analytic state
residual_definitions.map_floor: mapped analytic flux minus analytic flux, normalized only by the analytic grid-flux span
